messages.subject: 'pseudo' backcross
parts:
Dear Karl

I have a cross between a clonal line and an outbred. Do you think it
would be valid to analyse it as a backcross in R/qtl?

Thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] 'pseudo' backcross
parts:
Provided that you know phase in the outbred parent, it has the same structure as a backcross, and so may be analyzed that way in R/qtl or any other software.

karl
